==Notes==
{{research needed|Which effects do the Norn elite forms remove and which ones do they leave?}}
* When this skill is activated, most effects will be removed, including upkept enchantments, with some exceptions, but Ursan Blessing's effects still override any effects that affect attributes, health, or armor:
** Bundles will still be held, including carried [[item spell]] bundles, 
** Summoned creatures will not be dismissed upon having their related skills removed.
** Various skill effects: 
*** {{skill icon|Air of Superiority}}. Its 10% chance to recharge skills on kill may allow early use of Totem of Man and earlier reuse of the Blessing.
*** {{skill icon|Protector's Defense}}
*** {{skill icon|Signet of Stamina}}, but its effect is fully overriden. 
*** {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}
*** {{skill icon|"Together as One!"}}
*** {{skill icon|Never Rampage Alone}}
* For the first 30 seconds, it's impossible to use [[Totem of Man]] as it is recharging.
* When the blessing ends, the skill bar is reverted, and Ursan Blessing starts recharging.
* Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying [[bundle]]s.
* Combines well with [[Item Spell]]s that have an effect when dropped such as [[Protective Was Kaolai]] or [[ Blind Was Mingson]].
* Combines well with [[Binding Ritual]]s since spirits will be maintained upon transformation and their attacks are affected by Ursan Roar. 
* Temporary [[mission skill]]s such as [[Celestial Storm]] obtained while in this form will be lost upon leaving this form. They will be returned if they were received before entering this form
{{anomaly|Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.}}
{{bug|A new skill obtained (as a [[quest reward]]) while transformed may be used while in this form. After turning back to human form, the skill stays in the skill bar, but it becomes unusable until its position is swapped with another skill in the skills and attributes panel.}}

==Trivia==
*Since the [[Bear Spirit]] is female, the name of this skill is likely taken from the the Latin "ursa", meaning "female bear".
*After release of Guild Wars: Eye of the North, this skill was very powerful and was widely used by players to conquer high-end PvE content with relative ease for quite a while. After it became too dominant, the skill was nerfed and lost its role in the metagame.
